item.title: Texas bar shooting leaves 3 dead and 14 wounded as FBI investigates terrorism possibility
item.description: Authorities say three people — including a suspect — were killed and 14 others wounded in a shooting at a bar in Austin, Texas.

item.title: Local Jack and Jill of America chapter celebrates Founder’s Day
item.description: Jackson's Jack and Jill of America chapter had their Founder's Day and Mother's Day Tea on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Annual Blue Suede Dinner and Auction returns to the Hub City
item.description: The Carl Perkins Center for Child Abuse Exchange Club held their 32nd annual Blue Suede Dinner and Auction.

item.title: Suspect in Texas shooting wore ‘Property of Allah’ clothing and Iranian flag emblem, AP source says
item.description: A law enforcement official revealed to The Associated Press that the gunman who killed two people at Texas bar Sunday was wearing a sweatshirt that said, "Property of Allah," and another shirt with an Iranian flag on it.

item.title: Authorities confirm source of loud “booms” in Madison County
item.description: Several residents throughout Madison County and beyond reported hearing loud noises or "booms" just after 10 a.m. Sunday.

item.title: USJ presents Disney’s Descendants: The Musical
item.description: Some local students take the stage for a musical rendition of a popular kid’s movie.

item.title: ‘One Battle After Another,’ ‘Sinners’ face off at Actor Awards in final pre-Oscars showdown
